## My report

The paper by Bozio et al. argues, using six French reforms, that the perceived link between a payroll tax and the benefits it funds determines how much of the tax is passed on to workers’ earnings. In my report, I argue that one of their no-linkage reforms is a tax cut, which employers may pass on less for reasons unrelated to linkage, and I propose the 2007 exemption of overtime hours as a test. I also suggest allowing perceived linkage to vary across workers, for instance by age, and controlling for industry-specific shocks.
